timing: recorded after an infrastructure-only failed launch and before any benchmark score, completed pose, sensitivity result, or enrichment metric existed
trigger: the Windows Vina executable could not open scientifically valid receptor and ligand files whose absolute evidence paths exceeded its legacy path handling

common_failure.cause: the external executable rejected long absolute input paths before docking

changes.execution_input_transport: copy each already hash-verified receptor and ligand PDBQT byte-for-byte into a bounded short path beneath the create-only run root before invoking Vina
changes.staging_verification: require source and staged byte count and SHA-256 to match before execution
changes.path_preflight: reject an overlong external-tool path before the first entry attempt starts
changes.retry_policy: the aborted local root is retained as technical evidence and is never resumed or published; the corrected execution uses a new create-only root

invariants.vina_executable_and_arguments: unchanged except for byte-identical staged input paths and a new output root
